title: Definition of the arcsin
text: There is an angle $$\frac{-\pi}{2}$$ $$\leq$$ $$\theta$$ $$\leq$$ $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ such that $$\arcsin(1/2)=\theta$$

title: SOHCAHTOA
text: $$\sin(\theta)$$ is the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse of a right triangle with angle $$\theta$$

title: Important right triangles
text: The right triangle with opposite side length $$\frac{1}{2}$$ and hypotenuse $$1$$ is the $$30-60-90$$ triangle where the angle $$\theta$$ $$=\frac{\pi}{6}$$\n##figure1.gif##
